name: DUMBBELL REVERSE CURL
introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing backward. \n\nBend your elbows and lift the dumbbells towards your shoulders. Slowly return and repeat.

tips.text: Keep your arms close to your body.
Exhale as you lift the dumbbells, and inhale as you lower them.
This exercise works your biceps and forearms.
